name: two-timing
description: Two-Timing: Claude + ChatGPT. Two AIs. One brain. Run both from inside Claude Code as collaborators, not rivals: /duet drafts with one and stress-tests with the other, /route picks which AI (or which step) using an editable routing table, /second-opinion sends a finished answer to ChatGPT for a PASS / NEEDS REVISION check, /showdown compares them side by side, and /handoff packages context so either AI can pick up where the other left off.
